name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN–army fighting in Kivus; no major city fallen
summary: Army and Kabila-led FRN keep fighting in North and South Kivu; no change in control of Goma, Bukavu or Uvira found
state: Fighting continues between the army and the FRN, the Kabila-led coalition that succeeded AFC-M23, in North and South Kivu; the FRN advanced in South Kivu in early Nov and the army says it is preparing a counter-offensive (Al Jazeera, 18 Nov). The Doha and Washington peace tracks have not stopped the violence (Critical Threats, 11 Nov). Searches on 20 Nov found no major city changing hands and no confirmed direct interstate fighting, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in North and South Kivu face displacement and disrupted aid. UK nationals should follow FCDO advice against travel to eastern DR Congo.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting between army and FRN; no capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting

sources.title: Al Jazeera — DR Congo's rival peace efforts fail to halt violence in the east

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.

rubric.alert: Capture of a major city, or direct interstate fighting.
rubric.watch: Active fighting or a fragile ceasefire.
rubric.normal: Peace agreements holding; no major offensives.
